import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert Dt_Customer to datetime
df['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Dt_Customer'], format='%d-%m-%Y')

# Calculate total spending
df['Total_Spending'] = df[['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']].sum(axis=1)

# Plotting
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Total_Spending', hue='Marital_Status', palette='Set2')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Total Spending by Education Level and Marital Status')
plt.xlabel('Education Level')
plt.ylabel('Total Spending')
plt.legend(title='Marital Status', loc='upper right')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
